name: tab-warehouse
description: Dev tools only. The extension itself has no runtime dependencies.

scripts.test:fast: for f in $(find extension -name '*.js'); do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node --test tests/unit/
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage tests/unit/ 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (start|end) of coverage|^# file|^# -+$|^# extension/|^# (tests|pass|fail) '
